purpose: Score visual reference fidelity for this one saved CAD output, not model-wide performance.

criteria.description: Overall outer shape, low stance, relative wheelbase/track/body proportions. Judge visible proportions only; do not infer metric accuracy from a perspective image.
Four wheels, frame, seat, steering, engine, bodywork and bumpers in the reference-like arrangement. Count placement and presence here; detailed surface shape belongs below.

Reference-specific bucket seat, tapered nose and front bumper, steering wheel/column orientation, tire/rim geometry and curved frame shapes. Do not reward generic recognizability as precise shape matching.
Visible steering linkages, front axle joints, engine fins/casing, exhaust, rear drive/brake details and supports. Judge visible representation, not mechanical safety or operability.
Blue frame, gray/silver bodywork, dark seat and black tires in corresponding regions. Ignore background, lighting, camera choice and render polish.

anchors.25_percent: Only a coarse placeholder or major mismatch
anchors.75_percent: Mostly reference-like, with clear localized differences
anchors.100_percent: Close visual match in the observable evidence

method: Two independent image-based reviews using this frozen rubric, followed by parent reconciliation. Model identity is withheld from reviewers. This is judgment-based scoring, not an automatic image similarity metric.
